[SWS_DM_01783] Locking only for authorized
SOVD
clients
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04268
⌈
DM shall only allow a SOVD client to acquire a lock on the SOVD entity (or SOVD sub
entity) if the client is successfully authenticated. Otherwise the DM shall return HTTP
status code 401.
⌋
Note: Without an authorization token the DM would not be able to re-identify the client.
